title: Latvia's new coalition off to a slow start
summary_full: The new government has held its first coalition meeting, but there is still a lack of clarity on several key issues. The coalition partners have yet to agree on the responsibilities of the Deputy Prime Ministers, and the Prime Minister is also taking his time over the decision regarding the next head of the Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB), Latvian Television reported on November 23.
